title: [Riso] Auto Generate Lesson Name – Edit Lesson After First Save – Subject changed – Lesson Name unchanged

preconditions: Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Riso Salesforce org\nA Riso lesson exists with Subject = Math, Course = Course A, Lesson Name = Math - Course A (auto-generated on first save)\nSubject Master contains English
steps_actions:
1. Open the existing Riso lesson detail page
2. Click Edit on the lesson
3. Change Subject to English
4. Click Save
5. Observe the Lesson Name field on the detail page
steps_result:
1. Lesson Name shows Math - Course A
2. Lesson edit form opens; Lesson Name shows Math - Course A
3. Subject field shows English
4. Lesson saved without error
5. Lesson Name still = Math - Course A (not regenerated to English - Course A)

title: [Riso] Auto Generate Lesson Name – Lesson Name Field – Manual edit post-generation – Updated name persists on re-save

preconditions: Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Riso Salesforce org\nA Riso lesson exists with auto-generated Lesson Name = Math - Course A

1. Open the Riso lesson detail page
2. Click Edit
3. Clear the Lesson Name field and enter Custom Lesson Name
4. Click Save
5. Observe the Lesson Name field
6. Click Edit again without changing any field and click Save
7. Observe the Lesson Name field
steps_result:
1. Lesson Name = Math - Course A
2. Edit form opens
3. Lesson Name field shows Custom Lesson Name
4. Lesson saved
5. Lesson Name = Custom Lesson Name
6. Lesson saved
7. Lesson Name still = Custom Lesson Name (not reverted to Math - Course A)

title: [Riso] Auto Generate Lesson Name – Duplicate Lesson – First save of duplicate – Name auto-generated from source Subject and Course
description: AC 01.4 + BR-12 — State Transition — Duplicating a Riso lesson and saving the duplicate triggers auto-generation from the source lesson Subject and Course; pre-filled Lesson Name is overwritten.
preconditions: Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Riso Salesforce org\nA Riso source lesson exists with Subject = Math, Course = Course A, Lesson Name = Math - Course A
steps_actions:
1. Open the Riso source lesson (Lesson Name = Math - Course A)
2. Click Duplicate
3. Do not change Subject or Course
4. Fill required fields (date, time) and click Save
5. Open the duplicate lesson detail page
6. Observe the Lesson Name field
steps_result:
1. Lesson detail shows: Subject = Math, Course = Course A, Lesson Name = Math - Course A
2. New lesson creation form opens; Subject = Math and Course = Course A pre-filled from source
3. Fields remain as pre-filled
4. Duplicate lesson saved
5. Lesson detail loads
6. Lesson Name = Math - Course A (auto-generated from source Subject and Course on first save)

title: [Riso] Auto Generate Lesson Name – Back Office – Name created in SF – Visible in BO Lesson Detail and Lesson Management
description: AC 01.1 — Regression (cross-surface) — Lesson Name auto-generated in SF is visible and consistent in BO Lesson Detail and BO Lesson Management list.
preconditions: Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to both the Riso SF org and the Riso Back Office\nA Riso lesson has been created in SF with Subject = Math, Course = Course A; auto-generated Lesson Name = Math - Course A
steps_actions:
1. Open the Riso SF org lesson detail for the created lesson
2. Open the Riso Back Office and navigate to the same lesson Lesson Detail page
3. Observe the Lesson Name field in BO
4. Navigate to BO Lesson Management list and locate the lesson
5. Observe the Lesson Name column for this lesson
steps_result:
1. SF Lesson detail shows Lesson Name = Math - Course A
2. BO Lesson Detail page loads
3. Lesson Name = Math - Course A
4. Lesson appears in the BO list
5. Lesson Name column shows Math - Course A
